grain_rationale: row_count is 166158 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, meaning there are no exact duplicate rows and each row stands as one scheduled flight record, so grain_type is transaction. The derived identity flight_identity over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and sched_dep_hhmm uniquely identifies each flight line; because duplicate_row_rate is already 0.0 the identity tuple needs no aggregation to absorb duplication.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date the flight is scheduled on, ranging 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct dates with null_rate 0.0, used as part of the flight's degenerate identity.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter IATA carrier code (16 distinct values such as AA, DL, UA) with null_rate 0.0, identifying the operating airline.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number (range 1-8500, 2994 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a label rather than a measured quantity.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Three-letter origin airport code (EWR, JFK, LGA) with null_rate 0.0, identifying the New York-area departure airport.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as HHMM (range 500-2359, 969 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Three-letter destination airport code (100 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft tail registration number (3825 distinct values, e.g. N0EGMQ) with null_rate 0.009154, nullable likely due to unmatched or unregistered tail numbers in the source feed.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating the flight was cancelled (values true/false) with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time encoded as HHMM (range 1-2400, 1291 distinct values) with null_rate 0.029388; nullable because, per operator context, a flight that never departed keeps only its scheduled times.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes, negative when early (range -33 to 1301), with null_rate 0.029388 for flights lacking an actual departure; a measure compared and aggregated across flights.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time encoded as HHMM (range 1-2400, 1392 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0307, nullable for flights that never completed arrival.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM (range 1-2359, 1134 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes, negative when early (range -86 to 1272), with null_rate 0.032981 for flights lacking an actual arrival; a measure.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Actual flight air time in minutes (range 20-695) with null_rate 0.032981 for flights that never completed; a measure summed or averaged across flights.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles (range 80-4983) with null_rate 0.0; a measure.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure hour in local time (range 5-23, 19 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a decomposition of sched_dep_hhmm used as a label.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure minute in local time (range 0-59, 60 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a decomposition of sched_dep_hhmm used as a label.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: Scheduled departure instant truncated to the hour in UTC (hourly sample values from 2013-01-01T10:00:00, 3439 distinct values, min 2013-01-01T10:00:00, max 2013-07-01T03:00:00) with null_rate 0.0; the event timestamp for this fact, resolving to hour grain.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier legal name (16 distinct values, e.g. Delta Air Lines Inc.) with null_rate 0.0, joined from the carrier lookup per operator context.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer name (34 distinct values, e.g. BOEING, AIRBUS) with null_rate 0.160426, nullable where the aircraft registry join does not resolve, consistent with the operator context noting aircraft completeness sits above a floor rather than at completeness.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designator (121 distinct values) with null_rate 0.160426, nullable for the same unresolved aircraft-registry joins.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured (range 1956-2013) with null_rate 0.176531, a label rather than a summed measure, nullable where the aircraft registry does not resolve.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Aircraft seating capacity (range 2-450 seats) with null_rate 0.160426, a quantity measure, nullable where the aircraft registry join does not resolve.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type (6 categories, e.g. Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet) with null_rate 0.160426, nullable for unresolved aircraft-registry joins.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name (3 distinct values: John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport) with null_rate 0.0, joined from OurAirports per operator context noting origin completeness.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin airport's municipality (New York or Newark, 2 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21 ft, 3 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a static airport attribute rather than a per-flight measure.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511 ft, 3 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a static airport attribute.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name (99 distinct values) with null_rate 0.02089, nullable where the destination airports join does not resolve, per operator context on the destination completeness floor.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination airport's municipality (95 distinct values) with null_rate 0.02089, nullable for the same unresolved destination join.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: Destination airport's ISO region code (45 distinct values, e.g. US-CA) with null_rate 0.02089, nullable for the same unresolved destination join.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet (range 3-6606) with null_rate 0.02089, a static airport attribute, nullable where the destination join does not resolve.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet (range 5076-16000) with null_rate 0.02089, a static airport attribute, nullable for the same unresolved destination join.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline capture timestamp recorded at profiling time (16 distinct values clustered between 2026-09-02T23:25:51 and 2026-09-02T23:26:06) with null_rate 0.0; an ingestion artifact rather than the business event time, so it is mapped as a dimension instead of the fact's time field.

category_description: Each row represents one scheduled flight departing from a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) between 2013-01-01 and 2013-06-30, carrying its scheduled and actual departure and arrival times, delay minutes, distance, carrier identity, aircraft attributes from the registry join, and origin and destination airport attributes, as recorded in silver.silver_flights (row_count 166158, duplicate_row_rate 0.0).
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, naming the time column and its hour grain, the transaction-level grain with its degenerate flight identity, and every field's role, for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold fact and dimension models from the approved contract.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated by the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, and gated by human review and edit before approval; only after approval does the deterministic modeling engine read the contract to emit gold models, never this proposal directly.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or reclassify cancelled flights (is_cancelled, null_rate 0.0) or flights lacking actual departure or arrival times (dep_hhmm null_rate 0.029388, arr_hhmm null_rate 0.0307, dep_delay_minutes and arr_delay_minutes null_rate 0.029388 and 0.032981, air_time_minutes null_rate 0.032981), consistent with the operator context that a flight which never departed keeps only its scheduled times; such filtering is left to consumers. It also leaves unresolved the join-completeness gaps already declared in the table's own contract: aircraft attributes (aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_engine_type, aircraft_seat_count at null_rate 0.160426; aircraft_manufacture_year at null_rate 0.176531) and destination airport attributes (dest_airport_name, dest_municipality, dest_iso_region, dest_elevation_ft, dest_longest_runway_ft at null_rate 0.02089), which downstream consumers must handle according to those declared completeness floors.
